llm_model_summary: The user has consistently chosen the right side for feeding in various dining contexts. This preference appears to hold across different table types—rectangular and circular—and whether the setting is personal or social. The food items and dips on the plate do not seem to significantly influence the choice of feeding side, as the user continues to choose right regardless of what is being served. Therefore, for the variable `feeding_side`, the user's preference is to be fed from the right side.
